data.description:
## Description

**What**: Validation-class operational story (no implementation under it — live-evidence pass). After Phase 0 dry-run, Phase 1 bootstrap-strict, and Phase 2 bootstrap-throttle complete, runs cross-cutting audits: (a) duplicate-creation ACLI JQL audit cross-referenced with local jira-* tickets, (b) bridge-fsck label-only-orphan BEFORE -> AFTER, (c) no-duplicate-element invariant across 350 tickets, (d) 5 Phase-3 runs at <=5 mutations each.
**Why**: sc-1, sc-8, sc-10, sc-12 are properties of the rolled-out system, not of any single code path; this is the only place all four are jointly verifiable.
**Scope**:
- IN: Audit scripts gating each phase advance, evidence collection + attachment to epic ticket, operator phase-advance gate enforcement
- OUT: Any new code paths (validation-class, no implementation under this story)

## Done Definitions

- ACLI JQL `project = DIG AND labels NOT LIKE "dso-id-*" AND status != Closed AND created >= <epic-start-ts>` cross-referenced against `.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --status=open` filtered to jira-* IDs returns zero un-tracked DIG issues created during the epic; cross-reference output attached to epic ticket ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Bridge-fsck label-only-orphan count captured BEFORE Phase 1 starts is 197 (or current count at epic start) and the count captured AFTER bootstrap-throttle phase completes (i.e., after capped pass 8 = 5 bootstrap-strict passes + 3 bootstrap-throttle passes, total mutation budget 5x10 + 3x100 = 350) is 0; both counts attached to epic ticket. Note: SC-8's 'first 5 capped passes' is interpreted as the first 5 of the 8 total capped passes across bootstrap-strict + bootstrap-throttle phases, NOT only bootstrap-strict. ← Satisfies: sc-8
- After Phase 1+Phase 2 completion, for every synced ticket pair across all 350 bootstrapped tickets, comments_in_jira == comments_in_local, labels_in_jira (excluding dso-id) == labels_in_local, and links_in_jira == links_in_local; audit script output attached to epic ticket ← Satisfies: sc-12
- 5 consecutive workflow_dispatch runs in Phase 3 (live-uncapped) on converged state each exit 0 and each emit a manifest with <=5 mutations; the 5 run URLs and manifest sizes attached to epic ticket ← Satisfies: sc-10
- draft-8 audit invocations gate on explicit operator phase-advance signal (presence of .reconciler-phase-gate file at next phase, or operator comment on epic ticket transitioning audit state). Audit scripts refuse to execute against an unadvanced state, exiting with clear 'phase not advanced' message. Test: simulate audit against pre-Phase-1 state then audit exits non-zero with diagnostic, no false-fail evidence written. ← Validates Closure Check: "rollout phase advance is operator-gated"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] This story is gated by the operator manually advancing through the phase-gate lockfile; do not script the phase advance.
- [Observability] Each audit must be reproducible from logged inputs (timestamps, ticket lists, run URLs); failing to attach evidence to the epic ticket invalidates the audit.
- [Validation-class] This story is verification-only — no production code paths under it. Per project_d076_postmortem.md, completion-verifier must NOT auto-override validation-class SCs at closure; live evidence is required.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a reconciler operator, I want a rollout-completion audit gating each phase advance on explicit evidence (validation-class)
